what: Simulation Study: Empirical Coverage of Confidence Intervals
title: empirical-coverage
text: simulate data linear model check often confidence intervals constructed make_CI contain true value. demonstrates intervals correct coverage probability. empirical coverage close nominal coverage confidence level.
code: # Parameters n_sim <- 1000 n <- 50 beta <- c(2, 1, -1) sigma <- 1 alpha_levels <- c(0.05, 0.01)  # Storage for results results <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_sim, ncol = length(alpha_levels)) colnames(results) <- paste0("alpha_", alpha_levels)  for (sim in 1:n_sim) {   X <- cbind(1, rnorm(n), rnorm(n))   y <- X %*% beta + rnorm(n, sd = sigma)   gamma <- c(0, 1, 0)  # Test coverage for beta_2   for (j in seq_along(alpha_levels)) {     ci <- make_CI(y, X, alpha = alpha_levels[j], gamma = gamma)     # True value for beta_2 is 1     results[sim, j] <- (1 >= ci[1]) & (1 <= ci[2])   } }  empirical_coverage <- colMeans(results) data.frame(alpha = alpha_levels, nominal_coverage = 1 - alpha_levels, empirical_coverage) #>            alpha nominal_coverage empirical_coverage #> alpha_0.05  0.05             0.95              0.938 #> alpha_0.01  0.01             0.99              0.993

title: inference-demo
text: Suppose simple linear model two predictors:
code: n <- 100 X <- cbind(1, rnorm(n), rnorm(n))  # Intercept, X1, X2 beta <- c(2, 1, -1) sigma <- 1 y <- X %*% beta + rnorm(n, sd = sigma)

title: inference-demo
text: Estimate regression coefficients using find_beta:
code: beta_hat <- find_beta(y, X) beta_hat #>        X1        X2        X3  #>  1.933844  1.107640 -0.751965

what: Confidence Interval for a Linear Combination
title: inference-demo
text: Construct 95% confidence interval β2\beta_2 (coefficient X1):
code: gamma <- c(0, 1, 0)  # Selects beta_2 ci_beta2 <- make_CI(y, X, alpha = 0.05, gamma = gamma) ci_beta2 #> [1] 0.9129346 1.3023464

title: inference-demo
text: Suppose want estimate coefficients constraint β2+β3=0\beta_2 + \beta_3 = 0:
code: C <- matrix(c(0, 1, 1), nrow = 1)  # Constraint: beta_2 + beta_3 = 0 d <- 0 beta_hat_H <- find_betaH(y, X, C, d) beta_hat_H #>            [,1] #> [1,]  1.9671298 #> [2,]  0.9359443 #> [3,] -0.9359443

title: inference-demo
text: Test null hypothesis H0:β2+β3=0H_0: \beta_2 + \beta_3 = 0 using F-test based RSS:
code: f_rss <- f_test_RSS(y, X, C, d) f_rss #> $F_statistic #> [1] 6.174057 #>  #> $p_value #> [1] 0.01467634

title: inference-demo
text: Alternatively, use quadratic form test:
code: f_quad <- f_test_quad(y, X, C, d) f_quad #> $F_statistic #> [1] 6.174057 #>  #> $p_value #> [1] 0.01467634
